title: Soft and Fluffy Blueberry Muffins
excerpt: Classic muffins with a fluffy crumb thanks to a thorough initial beating and a high-heat start that gives them professional volume.
imageAlt: Baked fresh high-mountain blueberry muffins, fluffy and golden
steps: Beat the eggs with the sugar for at least 3 minutes, until you get a very fluffy mixture.
Stir in the butter, milk and lemon zest.
Mix the flour with the baking powder and fold it in gently.
Lightly flour the blueberries so they don’t sink to the bottom of the mold, and add them to the batter.
Let the batter rest in the fridge for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 210°C (410°F). Fill the molds two-thirds full and bake for 5 minutes at 210°C; then lower to 180°C (350°F) and bake 15–20 more minutes.
tips: The cold rest and the initial blast of high heat are what form the bakery-style “dome”.
Store them in an airtight container for up to 3 days, or freeze them individually for up to a month.
